assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE transparent raster GUI icon for a Japanese anime visual novel / bullet-hell game called Refrain, about a silver-haired digital maid recovering unsent messages. This icon is the AUTO-ADVANCE / PLAY control above the dialogue box.
Primary request: A single unmistakable solid right-pointing PLAY TRIANGLE, rendered as an elegant little luminous glass-and-silver enamel inlay. Front-facing orthographic UI artwork, not an object in perspective. Clean bold silhouette, softly faceted pale silver-white interior with a restrained mint-cyan reflection, very fine muted champagne-gold beveled edge. Crisp, tasteful anime-game interface finish, not realistic chrome, not a busy fantasy emblem. Strong pale silhouette that will remain readable on a charcoal dialogue panel at 20 pixels tall. The triangle points strictly RIGHT, not up. Optical center of the triangle at the center of the canvas.
Composition: square 1024x1024 canvas; one icon only centered; the visible triangle fills approximately 76% of canvas height and 66% of canvas width; ample fully transparent margin. Very thin local edge highlights only, no cast shadow or exterior glow that expands its bounds.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha PNG. No background, no checkerboard graphic, no framing square, no button backplate, no circle, no surrounding ornament, no writing, no letters, no words, no key labels, no watermark, no extra objects. Generate production-ready standalone icon art, NOT a UI screenshot.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE transparent raster FAST-FORWARD / READ-SKIP icon for the Refrain game dialogue toolbar.
Input image: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its pale silver-white faceted glass, soft mint-cyan reflections, very thin champagne-gold beveled rim and clean anime-game finish. Create a NEW different icon, not another single play icon.
Subject: exactly TWO equally sized right-pointing solid triangular play arrowheads side by side in one horizontal row, the universal FAST-FORWARD symbol. Both point strictly RIGHT. A small transparent gap separates them so both triangles read clearly when displayed 22 pixels wide. No enclosing plate, no underline, no extra triangle. Front-facing orthographic, no perspective. Simpler facets, strong pale silhouette, restrained details, no exterior glow or shadow.
Composition: square 1024x1024 canvas, two-triangle group centered, group fills about 80% of canvas width and 55% height, generous transparent margins. Each arrowhead equal size and identical style, evenly spaced. Strong simple shape suitable for a small dialogue UI.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha PNG. No background, no checkerboard graphic, no framing square, no words, no letters, no key labels, no watermark, no ornament. Production-ready standalone icon, NOT a screenshot.
